name: NVIDIA Quadro RTX 6000 (Turing, 24 GB)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Datasheet prints 'Memory Bandwidth 672 GB/s' next to 'Memory Interface 384-bit' and '24 GB GDDR6'. Arithmetic checks: 14 Gbps x 384 / 8 = 672 GB/s.

flops.basis_detail: Datasheet 'Single-Precision Performance 16.3 TFLOPS', footnote-free peak based on GPU boost. FP32 has no 2:4 sparse path, so dense:true.

notes: USED-MARKET WORKSTATION CARD. Predecessor of the Ampere RTX A6000 and the card people mean when a used listing says 'RTX 6000' without 'Ada'. 4608 CUDA cores, 576 Tensor cores, 72 RT cores, ECC, NVLink (two cards, 48 GB combined, only if the application supports it). Total board power 260 W, active dual-slot, PCIe 3.0 x16. Do not confuse with nvidia-rtx-6000-ada (48 GB, Ada, 960 GB/s) or nvidia-rtx-pro-6000-blackwell (96 GB).
